paragraphs.text: In many large cities, flat roofs are among the least used spaces. Over the last fifteen years, a growing number of companies have turned them into farms that grow vegetables, herbs and even fruit trees for local shops and restaurants.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Growing food on a roof is harder than it looks. Before any soil is laid, an engineer must check that the building can carry the extra weight, which can exceed 500 kilograms per square metre when the soil is wet. For this reason many rooftop farms use shallow beds or grow plants in water rather than soil.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Supporters argue that rooftop farms cut the distance food travels, keep buildings cooler in summer and give city residents a place to learn about growing food. A farm on a supermarket roof in Montreal, for example, supplies the shop below with fresh lettuce every day of the year.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Critics reply that rooftop farms produce only a tiny share of what a city eats. They also point out that the farms depend on the goodwill of building owners: several well-known projects closed when a building was sold and the new owner wanted the roof back.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Over the last fifteen years, a growing number of companies have turned them into farms
items.prompt: The first rooftop farms appeared about fifteen years ago.

explanation.en: “Over the last fifteen years, a growing number” — the number of companies has grown in that time. When the first rooftop farms appeared is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «Over the last fifteen years, a growing number» — 15 жылда мұндай компаниялар көбейген. Алғашқы шатыр-фермалар қашан пайда болғаны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «Over the last fifteen years, a growing number» — за 15 лет таких компаний стало больше. Когда появились первые крыши-фермы, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: Before any soil is laid, an engineer must check that the building can carry the extra weight
items.prompt: A building must be inspected before soil is added to its roof.

explanation.en: The text says: “Before any soil is laid, an engineer must check that the building can carry the extra weight”. An engineer’s check before the soil goes on is what “inspected before soil is added” means → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде: «Before any soil is laid, an engineer must check that the building can carry the extra weight». Топырақ төсемес бұрын инженердің тексеруі — дәл осы «inspected before soil is added» → TRUE.
explanation.ru: В тексте: «Before any soil is laid, an engineer must check that the building can carry the extra weight». Проверка инженером до укладки грунта — это и есть «inspected before soil is added» → TRUE.

items.quote: supplies the shop below with fresh lettuce every day of the year
items.prompt: The Montreal farm supplies lettuce only in summer.

explanation.en: “every day of the year” — all year, not only in summer. “Summer” in the same paragraph is about cooling buildings — a distractor → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «every day of the year» — жаз бойы ғана емес, жыл бойы. Сол абзацтағы «summer» ғимаратты салқындатуға қатысты — бұл алаңдатушы сөз → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «every day of the year» — круглый год, а не только летом. «Summer» в том же абзаце относится к охлаждению зданий — это дистрактор → FALSE.

items.quote: rooftop farms produce only a tiny share of what a city eats
items.prompt: Rooftop farms provide a large part of the food eaten in cities.

explanation.en: “only a tiny share of what a city eats” is the opposite of “a large part” → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «only a tiny share of what a city eats» — өте аз үлес «a large part» дегенге қарама-қарсы → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «only a tiny share of what a city eats» — крошечная доля противоположна «a large part» → FALSE.

items.quote: several well-known projects closed when a building was sold and the new owner wanted the roof back
items.prompt: Some rooftop farms have closed after a building changed owners.

explanation.en: “several well-known projects closed when a building was sold and the new owner wanted the roof back” — the building got a new owner and the farm closed. “Changed owners” paraphrases “was sold” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «several well-known projects closed when a building was sold and the new owner wanted the roof back» — ғимарат сатылып, жаңа иесі шығып, ферма жабылған. «Changed owners» деген «was sold» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «several well-known projects closed when a building was sold and the new owner wanted the roof back» — здание продали, у него новый владелец, и ферма закрылась. «Changed owners» пересказывает «was sold» → TRUE.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
